title: Unequal Voices: How LLMs Construct Constrained Queer Narratives

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures bias by comparing term frequencies of diversity-related words, using an LLM-as-a-judge to evaluate hyper-visibility and explicit focus on marginalized identities, and calculating topic divergence (Jensen-Shannon divergence) between generated narratives for queer versus non-queer personas across various social contexts.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
